import os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile

out = []
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='scogs_patristic_')
for zpath, group in [(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]), (sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4])]:
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(zpath)
    tree_names = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.treefile')]
    group_dir = os.path.join(work, group)
    os.makedirs(group_dir, exist_ok=True)
    for name in tree_names:
        path = os.path.join(group_dir, pathlib.Path(name).name)
        with open(path, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(z.read(name))
        proc = subprocess.run(['phykit', 'patristic_distances', path, '-v'],
                              capture_output=True, text=True)
        if proc.returncode != 0:
            continue
        vals = []
        for line in proc.stdout.splitlines():
            parts = line.split('\t')
            if not parts:
                continue
            try:
                vals.append(float(parts[-1]))
            except ValueError:
                pass
        if vals:
            out.append((group, name, sum(vals) / len(vals)))

out.sort()
for group, name, mean in out:
    print(f"{group}\t{name}\t{mean:.12g}")
PY
